title: davallia nephrodioides
intro: Davallia nephrodioides, commonly known as Davallia fern, is a type of fern that belongs to the Davallia genus. It is a vascular plant with health benefits, primarily used to treat various ailments such as fever, cough, and skin conditions. The therapeutic actions of Davallia fern include anti-inflammatory and antibacterial properties, which help to reduce inflammation and fight infections. The bioactive constituents of Davallia nephrodioides include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
